repair_plan: One bounded repair confined to docs/research_program/observational_publication_20261015/CONVERGENCE_20261028/products/R37-02-KINEMATICS/; preserve this failed candidate and receipts before writing a new candidate. (1) Restore the exact R36 physical parameterization A=k q-s, q=(B_o-B_s)/T_ref, s=dot B_o, k=2cT_ref/D, with q and s in the saved rate units. Retain all five null directions delta s=k delta q and the free-E2 rank-zero result; k=0 is the distant fixed-endpoint limit. (2) Freeze an explicitly assumed coefficient-level STF5 Frobenius remainder body ||e||<=r in microarcsec/year, with a=u+e and u=kq-s; this is a conditional sensitivity, never a measured bound. Reuse the saved primary selected_sample_full5_coefficients_uasyr as a_hat, F and the existing 5D chi-square 95% threshold 11.070497693516351. Compute the quotient identified image E95(a_hat,F) plus B5(r), with directional support v^T a_hat +/- [sqrt(q95 v^T F^-1 v)+r||v||]; eigenmode halfwidths are sqrt(q95/lambda_i)+r. Expose the full ten-parameter inverse fibre, retaining its five unbounded null directions. Do not relabel a whitened residual as a physical rate. If retaining the previous r/sqrt(lambda) diagnostic, label its r dimensionless and keep it separate. (3) Add a consumer-local safe optical call/branch or a narrowly declared numerical-domain guard. Exact zero must use maxabs==0 or equivalent, not a squared norm; representable small nonzero inverses use scaled S. Cover S=0, 1e-8*S_saved and 1e-200*S_saved, and explicitly reject nonfinite/unrepresentable inverse arithmetic rather than returning an exact-zero result. Frozen R36 files are read-only. (4) Correct the perpendicular-space dimension and trial-count source pointer; update affected JSON/CSV/prose/figure and candidate manifest consistently. (5) Run targeted tests of microarcsec-to-milliarcsec equivariance, the endpoint-difference witness, unit and zero physical remainder, support attainment/monotonicity, null-fibre invariance, and small-S branch behavior, plus the existing three tests. Reuse saved laws, MC rates and producer outputs; no catalogue fit, new MC, solver/ODE, original42 promotion or upstream source edits. Preserve first failures and the separate environment-correction receipt. Return a new candidate for fresh independent review; this plan does not itself admit it.
